app_identity.name: CONTINUUM
app_identity.tagline: Academic integrity has a memory problem.
app_identity.core_archetype: The Performance Pro & High-Density Technical Precision
app_identity.human_in_the_loop_principle: Non-accusatory behavioral deviation analytics. Surfaces longitudinal style drift & performance volatility for educator review.
app_identity.brand_motif: Continuous connected line, semester timeline nodes, glowing trace beams, high-density data matrix

theme.theme_support: Dark-first with clean Light Mode toggle

spacing_and_layout.card_style: bg-[#101622] border border-white/10 rounded-xl p-5 shadow-lg backdrop-blur-sm hover:border-sky-500/30 transition-all duration-200

key_components_guidelines.behavioral_deviation_index: 0-100 Gauge with color gradient, breakdown factors (Stylometric Drift %, Submission Velocity Spike, Performance Volatility), and clear risk band text.
key_components_guidelines.semester_timeline: 5-Semester horizontal slider or connected node line (Fall 2024 -> Spring 2026) showing historical submissions vs anomaly points.
key_components_guidelines.old_world_vs_continuum: Interactive comparison widget: Single-submission snapshot detection vs CONTINUUM multi-semester pattern contextual intelligence.
key_components_guidelines.responsible_ai_trust_callout: Banner emphasizing Educator-in-the-Loop, non-accusatory workflow, evidence ledger, and transparent feature weights.
key_components_guidelines.review_workspace: Side-by-side submission analysis, writing-style drift diff viewer, prompt history, and educator decision action bar (Approve, Request Interview, Clear Alert).

instructions_to_main_agent: Always wrap interactive elements in data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='sidebar-students-link', data-testid='student-profile-tab').
Ensure dark mode is default with dark background #07090E and clean high-contrast text #F8FAFC.
Implement Google Auth simulation on the login page with 'Enter Demo Account' instant bypass for quick testing.
Include real interactive charts using Recharts for longitudinal trends, performance bands, and signal distributions.
Keep the Series-A enterprise vibe: precise lines, monospace metrics, subtle cyan glows, structured tables with sort/filter/search.
